mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MT_LINK_VALUE_LATEST WHERE LINK_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM T_MT_LINK_INFO WHERE SOURCE_NODE_ID = #{nodeId} OR TARGET_NODE_ID = #{nodeId})
DELETE FROM T_MT_LINK_VALUE_HISTORY WHERE LINK_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM T_MT_LINK_INFO WHERE SOURCE_NODE_ID = #{nodeId} OR TARGET_NODE_ID = #{nodeId})
DELETE FROM T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF WHERE LINK_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM T_MT_LINK_INFO WHERE SOURCE_NODE_ID = #{nodeId} OR TARGET_NODE_ID = #{nodeId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MT_LINK_INFO WHERE SOURCE_NODE_ID = #{nodeId} OR TARGET_NODE_ID = #{nodeId}
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MT_METRIC_VALUE_LATEST WHERE NODE_ID = #{nodeId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MT_METRIC_VALUE_HISTORY WHERE NODE_ID = #{nodeId}) FROM DUAL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MT_ALERT_RULE WHERE UPPER(TARGET_TYPE) = UPPER(#{targetType}) AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MT_ALERT_RECORD SET STATUS = 'resolved', RESOLVE_TIME = SYSDATE, RESOLVE_TYPE = 'MANUAL' WHERE STATUS = 'active' AND UPPER(TARGET_TYPE) = UPPER(#{targetType}) AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MT_NODE_METRIC_DEF (ID, NODE_ID, METRIC_NAME, METRIC_UNIT, COLLECT_DESC, TIME_WINDOW, SORT_ORDER, CREATE_TIME) SELECT REPLACE(RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()), '-'), #{nodeId}, t.METRIC_NAME, t.METRIC_UNIT, t.COLLECT_DESC, t.TIME_WINDOW, t.SORT_ORDER, SYSDATE FROM T_MT_NODE_METRIC_TPL t WHERE t.STYLE_CLASS = #{styleClass} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MT_NODE_METRIC_DEF d WHERE d.NODE_ID = #{nodeId} AND d.METRIC_NAME = t.METRIC_NAME)

INSERT INTO T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF (ID, LINK_ID, METRIC_NAME, METRIC_UNIT, COLLECT_DESC, TIME_WINDOW, SORT_ORDER, CREATE_TIME) SELECT REPLACE(RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()), '-'), #{linkId}, t.METRIC_NAME, t.METRIC_UNIT, t.COLLECT_DESC, t.TIME_WINDOW, t.SORT_ORDER, SYSDATE FROM T_MT_LINK_METRIC_TPL t WHERE t.SOURCE_STYLE = #{sourceStyle} AND t.TARGET_STYLE = #{targetStyle} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MT_LINK_METRIC_DEF d WHERE d.LINK_ID = #{linkId} AND d.METRIC_NAME = t.METRIC_NAME)
